The question: wall began 1674, by 1690s already surrounded the city (land part closed by 1698/1702), but when definitively finished? Answer: 1797 (when moat/foso and covered way/camino cubierto were completed). Some sources say 1740 the wall enclosure was complete, but "final definitivo" = 1797.

I'll answer in Chinese (instructions say Chinese replies; question in Spanish though). The user asks in Spanish; probably answer in Spanish? System says 文档和回复都用中文. Hmm, the AGENTS.md says replies in Chinese. But the question is Spanish, likely a benchmark question. I'll answer in Chinese with Spanish year, maybe bilingual short. Keep simple.

Answer: 1797, when the moat (foso) and covered way (camino cubierto) were built. Cite Granma and Juventud Rebelde.

content.text:
**答案：1797 年。**

城墙于 1674 年 2 月 3 日动工，到 1690 年代已经合围了陆侧，即从 Punta 城堡经 Tenaza 到 San Francisco de Paula 一带；但整个防御工事要等到 **1797 年** 才最终完工，因为这一年才挖好壕沟（foso）并修好隐蔽通道（camino cubierto）。也就是说，整个工期从 1674 年一直持续到 1797 年，共 123 年。

依据：
- Granma《Trabajan en la recuperación de la Muralla》：“el proceso final de construcción total de la muralla culmina en 1797, cuando se hacen algunos fosos”
  https://www.granma.cu/la-habana-en-sus-500/2018-08-24/trabajan-en-la-recuperacion-de-la-muralla-un-legado-de-la-habana-24-08-2018-12-08-59
- Juventud Rebelde：“desde el 3 de febrero de 1674 hasta 1797”
  https://www.juventudrebelde.cu/index.php/columnas/lecturas/2024-12-07/defensas-habaneras-iii-y-final
